actionAdapters.when: 冻结字段触及已安装 Nova SDK/Kit 时，先确认目标包的 id、版本、source、根路径和文档入口
编辑并保存已冻结三维坐标的 ConfigMasterSO
扫描已加载 SDK/Kit Config 类型，或在精确坐标/矩阵范围内确认后补齐插件实例
只读校验精确 Config 坐标或定位其 Bundle Collector
确认精确 write set 后导出已冻结 Platform Channel DevelopMode 的 ConfigRuntimeSO

allow: confirmed ConfigMasterSO at the selected Platform Channel DevelopMode coordinate and explicit EnabledSDKs or EnabledKits members for the target Config types
resolved YooAssetSettings.asset for the confirmed coordinate when configured
active-scene startup snapshot only when explicitly confirmed
deny: unconfirmed SDK/Kit Config types or EnabledSDKs/EnabledKits members
SDKComponent.m_PluginEntries as an SDK enable source
remote config, CDN, Bundle, Player or external deployment

requiredFor: ambiguous ConfigMaster, coordinate, field change, runtime target or scene snapshot
ambiguous SDK/Kit package, Config type, package precondition or EnabledSDKs/EnabledKits membership
change another coordinate, resolved YooAsset settings or active scene snapshot
delete, external write, credential use, Git commit or push
confirmation.rule: 确认绑定一个三维坐标、字段变更和 Runtime 目标；SDK/Kit 还须绑定目标包、Config 类型和 EnabledSDKs/EnabledKits 成员。坐标、目标、目标类型或附加场景写入变化后旧确认失效。

evidence: ConfigMasterSO 保存与三维坐标证据
目标 SDK/Kit 的 package id、版本、source、INDEX、Scanner 类型发现与 EnabledSDKs/EnabledKits 单格映射证据（适用时）
